en.s: On 19 January 379, Emperor Gratian elevated Theodosius to Augustus at Sirmium, in present-day Serbia, giving him authority over the eastern Roman provinces.

zh.t: 狄奥多西被立为奥古斯都
zh.s: 公元379年1月19日，皇帝格拉提安在今塞尔维亚境内的锡尔米乌姆，将狄奥多西擢升为奥古斯都，授予他对罗马帝国东部各省的统治权。

en.t: Kuchan forces surrender after the siege of Aksu
en.s: On 19 January 649, Kuchan forces surrendered after a forty-day siege of Aksu by Tang general Ashina She’er. The surrender closed the Tang campaign against Kucha that had begun in 648, in the Tarim Basin of present-day China.

zh.t: 唐军围攻阿克苏后龟兹军投降
zh.s: 649年1月19日，唐将阿史那社尔围攻阿克苏四十天后，龟兹军队投降。这次投降结束了自648年开始的唐朝征讨龟兹行动，战场位于今中国塔里木盆地。

en.t: Truce of Malestroit ends an early phase of the Breton Succession War
en.s: On 19 January 1343, the Truce of Malestroit ended an early phase of fighting in the War of the Breton Succession in France. The wider dynastic conflict did not end with this truce.

zh.t: 马勒斯特鲁瓦停战结束布列塔尼继承战争早期战事
zh.s: 1343年1月19日，马勒斯特鲁瓦停战协议结束了法国布列塔尼继承战争的一个早期交战阶段，但整个王位继承冲突并未就此结束。

en.s: On 19 January 1421, John VIII Palaiologos was crowned Byzantine co-emperor alongside his father, Manuel II, in Constantinople, now Istanbul, Turkey.

zh.t: 约翰八世·巴列奥略加冕为共治皇帝
zh.s: 1421年1月19日，约翰八世·巴列奥略在君士坦丁堡，即今土耳其伊斯坦布尔，加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝，与父亲曼努埃尔二世共同执政。

en.t: End of the Portuguese siege of Tangier (1463–1464)
en.s: On 19 January 1464, the Portuguese siege of Tangier ended unsuccessfully. The attempt to capture the city, in present-day Morocco, had begun in November 1463.

zh.t: 葡萄牙围攻丹吉尔失败
zh.s: 1464年1月19日，葡萄牙围攻丹吉尔的行动以失败告终。这次试图夺取今摩洛哥丹吉尔的围城行动始于1463年11月。

en.s: The siege of Mirandola took place from 2 January to 19 January 1511 as a part of Pope Julius II's campaign to keep France from dominating northern Italy during the War of the League of Cambrai. At that time Mirandola was the capital of the Duchy of Mirandola in the Italian region of Emilia. The fortress was defended by 400 French infantrymen commanded by Alessandro Trivulzio, 100 soldiers from Ferrara, and 70 Mirandola soldiers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1511年1月2日至19日，米兰多拉围城战在康布雷同盟战争期间进行，是教皇尤利乌斯二世阻止法国控制意大利北部的军事行动之一。当时，米兰多拉是意大利艾米利亚地区米兰多拉公国的首都。堡垒由亚历山德罗·特里武尔齐奥指挥的400名法国步兵、100名费拉拉士兵和70名米兰多拉士兵守卫。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On 19 January 1520, forces supporting Christian II fought Sten Sture the Younger’s troops on the frozen Lake Åsunden near Bogesund, now Ulricehamn, Sweden. Sten Sture was mortally wounded and died on 3 February.

zh.s: 1520年1月19日，支持克里斯蒂安二世的军队与小斯滕·斯图雷的部队，在瑞典博格松附近结冰的奥松登湖交战。博格松即今乌尔里瑟港。小斯滕·斯图雷身负重伤，于2月3日去世。

en.s: The Battle of Braddock Down was a battle of the south-western campaign of the First English Civil War. It was fought on open ground in Cornwall, on 19 January 1643. An apparently easy victory for the Royalists under Sir Ralph Hopton secured Cornwall for King Charles and confirmed Hopton's reputation as a commander. Hopton also gained respect for the mercy shown to his foe, of whom 1,500 were captured during and after the battle. The precise location of the battlefield is a matter of dispute, though English Heritage believe it to be within parkland at Boconnoc.

zh.s: 1643年1月19日，第一次英国内战西南战役中的布拉多克丘陵战役，在康沃尔开阔地带展开。拉尔夫·霍普顿爵士率领保王军，似乎轻易就赢得胜利，为查理国王保住康沃尔，并巩固自己的指挥官声望。战斗中及战后约1,500名敌军被俘，他善待俘虏的做法也赢得尊重。战场确切位置仍有争议，英格兰遗产机构认为它位于博康诺克的园林内。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The siege of Uman was conducted by the Polish–Lithuanian–Crimean forces as part of the renewed campaign against the Cossack Hetmanate, on 14–19 January 1655.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1655年1月14日至19日，波兰—立陶宛与克里米亚联军围攻乌曼，这是其重新进攻哥萨克酋长国的军事行动之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Raid on Charles Town, or Spanish raid on New Providence, was a Spanish naval expedition on 19 January 1684 (O.S.) led by Cuban corsair Juan de Alarcón against the English privateering stronghold of Charles Town (later renamed Nassau), capital of the Bahamas. The Bahamian settlements and defenses were reduced to ruins, and the Spanish carried off the governor in chains, together with the inhabitants.

zh.s: 1684年旧历1月19日，古巴私掠船长胡安·德·阿拉尔孔率领西班牙海上远征队，突袭巴哈马首府、英国私掠船据点查尔斯镇，即后来的拿骚。巴哈马的聚落与防御工事遭到摧毁，西班牙人将总督戴上镣铐，并带走当地居民。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On 19 January 1705, Tunisian forces under Ibrahim al-Sharif laid siege to Tripoli, in present-day Libya. The attempt was unsuccessful and the Tunisian troops withdrew.

zh.s: 1705年1月19日，易卜拉欣·谢里夫率突尼斯军队围攻今利比亚的黎波里，但未能成功，随后撤军。

en.t: End of the unsuccessful British invasion of Martinique
en.s: On 19 January 1759, the British invasion attempt against Martinique ended in failure during the Seven Years’ War. British forces under Peregrine Hopson had landed on the French-held Caribbean island but were unable to capture it.

zh.t: 英军进攻马提尼克失败
zh.s: 1759年1月19日，七年战争期间，英军进攻马提尼克的行动以失败告终。佩里格林·霍普森率英军登陆这座法国控制的加勒比岛屿，但未能占领全岛。

en.t: 1791 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1791 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 19, 1791, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate. The election was conducted by a system of approval voting. Incumbent Senator Philip Schuyler was not re-elected.

zh.t: 1791年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1791年1月19日，纽约州议会采用认可投票制，选举该州第一组联邦参议员席位的代表。现任参议员菲利普·斯凯勒未能连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: The Batavian Republic is proclaimed in the Netherlands, replacing the Dutch Republic
en.s: The Batavian Republic was the successor state to the Republic of the Seven United Netherlands. It was proclaimed on 19 January 1795 after the Batavian Revolution and ended on 5 June 1806, with the accession of Louis Bonaparte to the Dutch throne. From October 1801 onward, it was known as the Batavian Commonwealth.

zh.t: 巴达维亚共和国宣告成立
zh.s: 巴达维亚共和国是尼德兰七省联合共和国的继承国，于巴达维亚革命后的1795年1月19日宣告成立，1806年6月5日随着路易·波拿巴登上荷兰王位而终结。自1801年10月起，该国改称巴达维亚联邦。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The action of 19 January 1799 was a minor naval battle of the French Revolutionary Wars fought in waters of the Strait of Gibraltar, off Punta Europa. A Spanish squadron of 14 gunboats with a mistico as flagship, commanded by Francisco Mourelle de la Rua, attacked a British merchant convoy escorted by several Royal Navy warships, among them a 74-gun ship of the line.

zh.s: 1799年1月19日海战是法国大革命战争期间的一场小规模海战，发生在欧罗巴角外的直布罗陀海峡水域。弗朗西斯科·穆雷列·德·拉鲁阿率领14艘西班牙炮艇，以一艘米斯蒂科帆船为旗舰，攻击由数艘英国皇家海军军舰护航的英国商船队，护航舰只中包括一艘配备74门火炮的战列舰。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The battle of Paraguarí took place on January 19, 1811, in Paraguarí (Paraguay), between the patriot army led by Manuel Belgrano and the Royalist army located in Paraguay led by Bernardo de Velasco. The battle would end with a Paraguayan victory; but it boosted confidence in the local population to declare themselves independent from both Buenos Aires patriots and royalists months later.

zh.s: 1811年1月19日，曼努埃尔·贝尔格拉诺率领的爱国派军队，与贝尔纳多·德·贝拉斯科指挥、驻在巴拉圭的保王军，在巴拉瓜里交战。巴拉圭一方最终获胜，也增强了当地民众的信心，使他们在几个月后宣布既不受布宜诺斯艾利斯爱国派、也不受保王派统治而独立。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 19 January 1817, the Army of the Andes began its crossing from Argentina towards Chile. The force included Argentine soldiers and Chilean exiles and aimed to fight Spanish rule in Chile.

zh.s: 1817年1月19日，安第斯军开始从阿根廷翻越安第斯山脉前往智利。部队包括阿根廷士兵和流亡的智利人，目标是打击西班牙在智利的统治。

en.s: The battle of Torata is part of the Peruvian War of Independence, which occurred on January 19, 1823 in the high Torata (town located northeast of Moquegua) between the Liberation Army of Peru, under command of Argentinean General Rudecindo Alvarado, and Royal Army of Peru under Gen. Brigadier Jerónimo Valdés and culminated with the defeat of patriots whose army would be completely destroyed two days later at the Battle of Moquegua with support of Gen José de Canterac.

zh.s: 1823年1月19日，秘鲁独立战争中的托拉塔战役，在莫克瓜东北的托拉塔高地展开。阿根廷将军鲁德辛多·阿尔瓦拉多指挥秘鲁解放军，迎战赫罗尼莫·巴尔德斯准将的秘鲁王家军，最终爱国派战败。两天后的莫克瓜战役中，在何塞·德·坎特拉克将军支援下，保王军彻底击溃了这支爱国派军队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 19 January 1839, British naval forces captured Aden, in present-day Yemen. Britain sought to use the port as a coaling station for steamships on the Suez–Bombay route.

zh.s: 1839年1月19日，英国海军占领今也门的亚丁。英国希望将该港用作苏伊士至孟买航线蒸汽船的加煤站。

en.s: On 19 January 1853, Giuseppe Verdi’s opera Il trovatore premiered at the Teatro Apollo in Rome, Italy.

zh.t: 威尔第歌剧《游吟诗人》首演
zh.s: 1853年1月19日，朱塞佩·威尔第的歌剧《游吟诗人》在意大利罗马阿波罗剧院首演。

en.s: On 19 January 1860, Henry Sewell won the Town of Christchurch parliamentary by-election in New Zealand, defeating Michael Hart by 77 votes to 33. The by-election followed Richard Packer’s resignation.

zh.s: 1860年1月19日，新西兰基督城选区举行议会补选，亨利·休厄尔以77票对33票击败迈克尔·哈特。补选因理查德·帕克辞职而举行。

loc: 美国肯塔基州普拉斯基县

en.s: The Battle of Mill Springs, also known as the Battle of Fishing Creek in Confederate terminology, and the Battle of Logan's Cross Roads in Union terminology, was fought in Wayne and Pulaski counties, near current Nancy, Kentucky, on January 19, 1862, as part of the American Civil War. The Union victory concluded an early Confederate offensive campaign in eastern Kentucky. In late 1861, Confederate Brig. Gen. Felix Zollicoffer guarded Cumberland Gap, the eastern end of a defensive line extending from Columbus, Kentucky. In November he advanced west into Kentucky to strengthen control in the area around Somerset and made Mill Springs his winter quarters, taking advantage of a strong defensive position.

zh.s: 1862年1月19日，美国内战中的米尔斯普林斯战役，在肯塔基州今南希附近的韦恩县及普拉斯基县展开。邦联称其为菲欣溪战役，联邦军称洛根十字路口战役。联邦军获胜，结束了邦联在肯塔基东部早期发动的攻势。1861年底，邦联费利克斯·佐利科弗准将守卫坎伯兰山口，即从肯塔基哥伦布延伸过来的防线东端。11月，他向西进入肯塔基，意在加强对萨默塞特周边的控制，并利用米尔斯普林斯有利的防御地形，在那里过冬。

en.t: 1869 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1869 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on January 19, 1869. Incumbent Charles Sumner was re-elected to a fourth term in office. At the time, Massachusetts elected United States senators by a majority vote of each separate house of the Massachusetts General Court: the House and the Senate.

zh.t: 1869年美国马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1869年1月19日，马萨诸塞州举行联邦参议员选举，现任查尔斯·萨姆纳获选第四个任期。当时，联邦参议员由州议会参众两院分别以多数票选出。

en.t: 1869 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1869 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 19, 1869, by the New York State Legislature. Incumbent Senator Edwin D. Morgan stood for a second term in office, but lost the support of the Republican legislative caucus in favor of Reuben Fenton.

zh.s: 1869年1月19日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举。现任参议员埃德温·D.摩根寻求连任，但失去共和党州议会党团的支持，党团转而支持鲁本·芬顿。

en.s: The (Second) Battle of Buzenval, also known as the Battle of Mont Valérien, was part of the siege of Paris during the Franco-Prussian War. On January 19, 1871, the day after Wilhelm I was proclaimed German Emperor, Louis Jules Trochu attacked the Germans west of Paris in Buzenval Park. The attackers seized the town of Saint-Cloud, coming close to the new Emperor's headquarters at Versailles. Trochu was able to maintain his position at St. Cloud for most of the day, but the failure of other French forces to hold their positions left him isolated and the Crown Prince's army was able to force Trochu's salient back into Paris by the next day.

zh.t: 第二次比藏瓦尔战役（1871年）
zh.s: 1871年1月19日，普法战争围困巴黎期间，路易·朱尔·特罗胥在比藏瓦尔公园向巴黎以西的德军发动进攻。此战也称瓦莱里安山战役，发生在威廉一世被宣布为德意志皇帝的次日。法军夺取圣克卢镇，接近新皇帝位于凡尔赛的总部。特罗胥在当天大部分时间守住圣克卢，但其他法军未能保住阵地，使他陷于孤立。到次日，普鲁士王储的军队已把其突出部逼回巴黎。

en.s: On 19 January 1871, Prussian forces under August Karl von Goeben defeated Louis Faidherbe’s French forces near Saint-Quentin, France, during the Franco-Prussian War. The defeat frustrated efforts to relieve besieged Paris.

zh.s: 1871年1月19日，普法战争期间，奥古斯特·卡尔·冯·格本率普鲁士军队在法国圣康坦附近击败路易·费代尔布率领的法军，挫败了解救被围巴黎的行动。

en.s: The Battle of Abu Kru (also known as the Battle of Gubat) was part of the British Sudan campaign. It was fought on 19 January 1885, two days after the Battle of Abu Klea, between the British and the Mahdists. The British force under Brigadier General Sir Herbert Stewart numbered 1,200 while a large number of Mahdists, probably around 13,000–14,000, were in pursuit.

zh.s: 1885年1月19日，英国苏丹战役中的阿布克鲁战役爆发，也称古巴特战役，距离阿布克利亚战役仅两天。赫伯特·斯图尔特爵士准将率领1,200名英军，与大批追击而来的马赫迪军交战，对方人数可能约为13,000至14,000人。

en.t: 1893 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1893 United States Senate election in California was held on January 19, 1893, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, former Democratic Lieutenant Governor Stephen M. White was elected over former Republican Governor George C. Perkins, incumbent Republican Senator Charles N.

zh.t: 1893年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1893年1月19日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，改选该州第一组席位。在两院特别联席会议上，民主党籍前副州长斯蒂芬·M.怀特当选，击败共和党籍前州长乔治·C.珀金斯等对手。原文在列举另一名对手、共和党现任参议员“查尔斯·N.”时中断。

en.t: 1897 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1897 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 19, 1897, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1897年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1897年1月19日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第三组参议员席位的代表。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1909
en.s: The 1909 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on January 19, 1909. Boies Penrose was re-elected by the Pennsylvania General Assembly to the United States Senate. This was the last Class III U.S. Senate election to be decided by the Pennsylvania General Assembly before the ratification of the 17th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, which mandated direct election of U.S. Senators.

zh.t: 1909年美国宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1909年1月19日，宾夕法尼亚州举行联邦参议员选举，州议会选出博伊斯·彭罗斯连任。这是在美国宪法第十七修正案获批准、规定参议员直接民选前，该州议会最后一次决定第三组参议员席位的人选。

en.t: 1909 Cavite's at-large Philippine Assembly district special election
en.s: A special election (known elsewhere as "by-elections") for the seat of Cavite's at-large district in the Philippine Assembly, the lower house of the Philippine Legislature of the Insular Government of the Philippine Islands, was held on January 19, 1909. This was triggered due to the appointment of the incumbent Rafael Palma as a member of the Philippine Commission. Emiliano Tría Tirona won the special election.

zh.t: 1909年菲律宾甲米地全省议席特别选举
zh.s: 1909年1月19日，菲律宾议会下院的甲米地全省选区举行特别选举，也就是补选。该下院属于菲律宾群岛岛屿政府的立法机关。现任拉斐尔·帕尔马获任菲律宾委员会委员，因此留下空缺。埃米利亚诺·特里亚·蒂罗纳赢得补选。

en.t: 1909 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1909 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 19, 1909, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1909年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1909年1月19日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第三组参议员席位的代表。

en.s: The 1912 Sanitary Board Election was held on 19 January 1912 for the 2 unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. Only ratepayers who were included in the Special and Common Jury Lists of the years or ratepayers who are exempted from serving on Juries on account of their professional avocations, unofficial members of the Executive or Legislative Council, or categories of profession were entitled to vote at the election.

zh.s: 1912年1月19日，香港洁净局举行两个非官守议席的选举。只有符合特定条件的纳税人才有投票资格，包括列入当年特别或普通陪审员名单者，因职业而获豁免担任陪审员者，行政局或立法局非官守成员，以及指定专业类别人士。

en.s: The Battle of Jassin (also known as the Battle of Yasin, the Battle of Jasin, the Battle of Jasini or the Battle of Jassini) was a World War I battle that took place on 18– 19 January 1915 at Jassin on the German East African side of the border with British East Africa between a German Schutztruppe force and British and Indian troops.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 贾辛战役发生于第一次世界大战期间，时间为1915年1月18日至19日，地点在德属东非与英属东非交界处的德属一侧贾辛。交战双方为德国殖民地保安军与英国、印度军队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 19 January 1915, German airships bombed towns in Norfolk, England. The raid marked the opening of the major German airship bombing campaign against Britain during the First World War.

zh.t: 德国飞艇轰炸英国诺福克
zh.s: 1915年1月19日，德国飞艇轰炸英格兰诺福克的城镇，揭开第一次世界大战期间德国对英国大规模飞艇轰炸行动的序幕。

en.s: The Battle of Köprüköy was a major engagement of the Caucasus Campaign during World War I. Occurring between January 10 and 19, 1916, it resulted in a decisive victory for the Russian Empire and broke the Ottoman defensive lines protecting Erzurum.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科普鲁科伊战役是第一次世界大战高加索战役中的一次重要交战，从1916年1月10日持续至19日。俄罗斯帝国取得决定性胜利，突破了保护埃尔祖鲁姆的奥斯曼防线。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Silvertown explosion occurred in Silvertown in West Ham, Essex (now part of the London Borough of Newham) on Friday, 19 January 1917 at 6:52 p.m. The blast occurred at a munitions factory that was manufacturing explosives for Britain's First World War military effort. Approximately 50 tonnes of trinitrotoluene (TNT) exploded, killing 73 people and injuring 400 more, as well as causing substantial damage in the local area.

zh.s: 1917年1月19日星期五18时52分，英国埃塞克斯郡西汉姆的银镇，今属伦敦纽汉区，一家为第一次世界大战生产炸药的军工厂发生爆炸。约50吨三硝基甲苯，即TNT，爆炸，造成73人死亡、400人受伤，并使周边地区严重受损。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 19 January 1919, although members of the standing army in the east voted for their representatives only on 2 February. The elections were the first of the new Weimar Republic following World War I and the Revolution of 1918–19. It was also the first German election held using proportional representation and with women's suffrage. It is also reckoned as the first truly free and fair all-German election, as it was the first to be held after the scrapping of the old constituencies that grossly over-represented rural areas.

zh.s: 1919年1月19日，德国举行全国选举，东部常备军成员则直到2月2日才投票选出其代表。这是第一次世界大战及1918—1919年革命之后，新生魏玛共和国的首次选举，也是德国首次采用比例代表制、允许女性投票的全国选举。由于此前严重偏向农村地区的旧选区划分已被废除，它也被视为首次真正自由、公平的全德选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On January 19, 1919, fighting at Ust-Padenga in northern Russia resulted in a Soviet victory and an American retreat. It formed part of the larger Shenkursk campaign during the Russian Civil War.

zh.s: 1919年1月19日，俄罗斯北部乌斯季帕坚加的战斗以苏维埃军队获胜、美军撤退告终。这是俄国内战期间申库尔斯克战役的一部分。

en.s: On January 19, 1920, directors of the Civil Liberties Bureau formed a new organization under the name American Civil Liberties Union in the United States.

zh.t: 美国公民自由联盟成立
zh.s: 1920年1月19日，公民自由局的理事在美国以“美国公民自由联盟”之名组建新组织。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1932 was held on January 19, 1932. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party had virtually no electoral support. This meant that the Democratic Party primary held on this date was the real contest over who would be governor. The election resulted in the election of Oscar K. Allen as governor of Louisiana. Louisiana was one of only two states that held the election on a date other than the first Tuesday following the first Monday of November.

zh.t: 1932年美国路易斯安那州州长选举
zh.s: 1932年1月19日，路易斯安那州举行州长选举。与重建时期至民权运动年代之间多数南方州一样，该州共和党几乎没有选举支持，因此当天民主党初选才是真正决定州长人选的角逐。奥斯卡·K.艾伦最终当选。路易斯安那是当时仅有的两个不在11月第一个星期一之后的星期二举行选举的州之一。

en.t: Central Red Army headquarters leaves Zunyi
en.s: On 19 January 1935, the Central Red Army headquarters and central column left Zunyi, China, and headed north. They planned to cross the Yangtze through southern Sichuan and join the Fourth Front Army. This departure preceded the later crossings of the Chishui River.

zh.t: 中央红军总部撤离遵义北上
zh.s: 1935年1月19日，中央纵队和中央红军总部撤出遵义城，向北进发，准备经川南渡过长江，与红四方面军会合。这次出发早于后来实际进行的四渡赤水。

en.s: Local elections were held in Liechtenstein on 19 January 1936 to elect the municipal councils and the mayors of the eleven municipalities.

zh.s: 1936年1月19日，列支敦士登举行地方选举，选出十一个市镇的议会及市镇长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: End of the fighting at Gnojno
en.s: On 19 January 1944, the two-day fighting at Gnojno, in present-day Ukraine, ended. Poland’s Home Army had attacked a Ukrainian Insurgent Army base during attempts to take control of the area after the German withdrawal.

zh.s: 1944年1月19日，今乌克兰境内格诺伊诺为期两天的战斗结束。波兰家乡军在德军撤离后争夺当地控制权的行动中，攻击了乌克兰起义军的一处基地。

en.t: Yan Xishan orders the Houma offensive
en.s: On 19 January 1946, Yan Xishan ordered his 13th Army Group to send the 34th Army south from Linfen along the Datong–Puzhou railway. The order opened the Houma campaign between Nationalist and Communist forces in China.

zh.t: 阎锡山下令发动侯马方向攻势
zh.s: 1946年1月19日，阎锡山命令第十三集团军调第三十四军从临汾沿同蒲铁路南下，国共双方的侯马战役由此展开。

en.t: Charter of the International Military Tribunal for the Far East issued
en.s: On January 19, 1946, the charter establishing the International Military Tribunal for the Far East was issued in Tokyo, Japan, under General Douglas MacArthur’s authority. The trial opened later, on April 29, 1946.

zh.t: 《远东国际军事法庭宪章》颁布
zh.s: 1946年1月19日，道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军授权在日本东京颁布设立远东国际军事法庭的宪章。审判于同年4月29日开庭。

en.t: PLA air raid targets the Dachen Islands
en.s: On 19 January 1955, the People’s Liberation Army carried out its first bombing mission specifically targeting the Dachen Islands off the coast of Zhejiang, China, during the First Taiwan Strait Crisis.

zh.s: 1955年1月19日，第一次台海危机期间，中国人民解放军对浙江沿海大陈岛实施首次专门针对该地的轰炸任务。

en.s: General elections were held in Guatemala on 19 January 1958 after the 1957 elections were nullified. After no candidate received 50% or more of the national vote, Miguel Ydígoras Fuentes was elected President by Congress on 12 February, whilst an alliance of the National Democratic Reconciliation Party, Nationalist Democratic Party, the Nationalist Liberal Party, the Democratic National Association and the National Anti-Communist Front won 40 of the 66 seats in Congress.

zh.s: 1957年选举被宣布无效后，危地马拉于1958年1月19日再次举行大选。没有总统候选人取得至少50%的全国选票，国会因此于2月12日选出米格尔·伊迪戈拉斯·富恩特斯担任总统。由国家民主和解党、民族主义民主党、民族主义自由党、民主民族协会及全国反共阵线组成的联盟，赢得国会66席中的40席。

en.s: Scandinavian Airlines System Flight 871 was a scheduled flight from Copenhagen in Denmark to the Egyptian capital of Cairo, with several intermediate stops, operated by Scandinavian Airlines System. On 19 January 1960, the Sud Aviation Caravelle flying the service crashed while operating a leg between Yeşilköy Airport, Turkey and Esenboğa International Airport in Turkey.

zh.s: 北欧航空871号班机是由北欧航空运营、从丹麦哥本哈根飞往埃及首都开罗的定期航班，途中设有数个经停站。1960年1月19日，执行该航班的南方航空“快帆”客机在土耳其耶希尔柯伊机场至埃森博阿国际机场的航段中坠毁。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: On January 19, 1960, the United States and Japan signed the Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security in Washington, D.C. The treaty addressed US military facilities in Japan and defence commitments concerning territories under Japanese administration.

zh.t: 日美签署《共同合作和安全条约》
zh.s: 1960年1月19日，美国与日本在华盛顿签署《共同合作和安全条约》，涉及驻日美军设施，以及与日本施政领土有关的防卫义务。

en.t: Indira Gandhi elected Congress parliamentary leader
en.s: On January 19, 1966, Indira Gandhi was elected leader of the Congress Party in India’s Parliament. She was sworn in as prime minister on January 24, becoming India’s first female prime minister.

zh.t: 英迪拉·甘地当选国大党议会党团领袖
zh.s: 1966年1月19日，英迪拉·甘地当选印度国大党议会党团领袖。她于1月24日宣誓就任总理，成为印度首位女性总理。

en.t: Opening of the Battle of the Paracel Islands
en.s: On 19 January 1974, Chinese and South Vietnamese naval forces began fighting near the Paracel Islands in the South China Sea. The engagement continued into 20 January.

zh.s: 1974年1月19日，中国与南越海军在南海西沙群岛附近开始交战，战斗持续至1月20日。

en.s: The 1976 Iowa Democratic presidential caucuses were held on January 19, 1976, the first nominating contest in the Democratic presidential primaries for the 1976 presidential election. It had the little-known Governor of Georgia Jimmy Carter campaign heavily and end up capturing 27.7% of the vote, the highest of the five candidates. An outpouring of media coverage of Carter soon emerged.

zh.t: 1976年美国民主党艾奥瓦州总统候选人党团会议
zh.s: 1976年1月19日，民主党在艾奥瓦州举行总统候选人党团会议，是当年该党总统初选的首场提名角逐。知名度不高的佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特在当地积极竞选，最终获得27.7%的选票，在五名候选人中最高。随后，媒体开始大量报道卡特。

en.s: Trans-Colorado Airlines Flight 2286 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Denver, Colorado, United States, to Durango, Colorado, United States, operated for Continental Express by Trans-Colorado Airlines. On January 19, 1988, the Swearingen Metroliner crashed onto terrain near Bayfield, Colorado, while on approach to Durango-La Plata County Airport. Out of the 17 people on board, 9 were killed, including both crew members.

zh.t: 跨科罗拉多航空2286号班机空难
zh.s: 1988年1月19日，一架执飞跨科罗拉多航空2286号班机的斯韦林根Metroliner客机，在进近杜兰戈—拉普拉塔县机场时，于科罗拉多州贝菲尔德附近撞地。机上17人中有九人死亡，包括两名机组人员。这是由跨科罗拉多航空代表大陆快运运营、从科罗拉多州丹佛飞往杜兰戈的定期国内客运航班。

en.s: Royal Rumble (1991) was the fourth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on January 19, 1991, at the Miami Arena in Miami, Florida. The main event was the 1991 Royal Rumble match won by Hulk Hogan, who last eliminated Earthquake to win the match. Featured matches on the undercard were The Ultimate Warrior versus Sgt. Slaughter for the WWF World Heavyweight Championship, Ted DiBiase and Virgil versus Dusty Rhodes and Dustin Rhodes and The Mountie versus Koko B. Ware.

zh.s: 1991年1月19日，世界摔角联盟（WWF）在美国佛罗里达州迈阿密竞技场，举办第四届年度“皇家大战”按次付费职业摔角赛。压轴皇家大战中，胡克·霍根最后淘汰Earthquake获胜。其他重点比赛包括：终极战士对阵Sgt. Slaughter，争夺WWF世界重量级冠军；泰德·迪比亚兹与Virgil对阵达斯蒂·罗兹及达斯汀·罗兹；The Mountie对阵Koko B. Ware。

en.s: On 19 January 1991, US aircraft carried out the Package Q airstrike against targets in Baghdad, Iraq, during the Gulf War. The mission led to revisions in US airstrike tactics.

zh.s: 1991年1月19日，海湾战争期间，美军飞机对伊拉克巴格达的目标实施“Q编队”空袭。行动之后，美军调整了空袭战术。

en.t: End of the Battle of Ad-Dawrah
en.s: On 19 January 1991, Coalition forces completed the capture of the Iraqi Ad-Dawrah offshore oil facilities during the Gulf War. The engagement had begun on the night of 18 January.

zh.s: 1991年1月19日，海湾战争期间，多国部队完成对伊拉克阿德道拉海上石油设施的占领。战斗始于1月18日晚。

en.s: The 1992 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the fifth annual Royal Rumble event and took place on January 19, 1992, at the Knickerbocker Arena in Albany, New York. It centered on the men's Royal Rumble match, a modified 30-man battle royal in which the participants enter at timed intervals instead of all beginning in the ring at the same time.

zh.s: 1992年1月19日，世界摔角联盟（WWF，今WWE）在纽约州奥尔巴尼的尼克博克竞技场举办第五届年度皇家大战付费电视赛事。赛事的核心是男子皇家大战，采用30人淘汰赛的变体规则：参赛者按固定时间间隔依次进场，而不是同时站上擂台。

en.s: Direct presidential elections were held for the first time in Bulgaria on 12 January 1992, with a second round on 19 January. The result was a victory for incumbent President Zhelyu Zhelev of the Union of Democratic Forces, who won 52.8% of the vote in the second round. Voter turnout was 75.4% in the first round and 75.9% in the second.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1992年保加利亚总统选举第二轮
zh.s: 保加利亚于1992年1月12日首次举行总统直选，并于1月19日举行第二轮投票。民主力量联盟的现任总统热柳·热列夫在第二轮获得52.8%的选票，赢得选举。第一轮投票率为75.4%，第二轮为75.9%。
zh.n: 此条记录资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: On January 19, 1994, Pancrase held Pancrash! 1 at the Yokohama Cultural Gymnasium in Yokohama, Japan.

zh.s: 1994年1月19日，Pancrase在日本横滨文化体育馆举办Pancrash! 1综合格斗赛事。

en.s: Bristow Helicopters Flight 56C was a helicopter flight that flew between Aberdeen and the Brae Alpha oil rig in the North Sea. On 19 January 1995, the AS 332L Super Puma helicopter operating the route, registered G-TIGK and named Cullen, was struck by lightning. The flight was carrying 16 oil workers from Aberdeen to an oil platform at the Brae oilfield. All 18 people on board survived.

zh.t: 布里斯托直升机56C号航班遭雷击
zh.s: 布里斯托直升机56C号航班往返于阿伯丁和北海布雷阿尔法石油平台之间。1995年1月19日，执行该航班、注册编号为G-TIGK并命名为“卡伦”的AS 332L“超级美洲豹”直升机遭到雷击。航班当时正运送16名石油工人从阿伯丁前往布雷油田的一座平台，机上18人全部生还。

en.t: The barge North Cape oil spill occurs as an engine fire forces the tugboat Scandia ashore on Moonstone Beach in South Kingstown, Rhode Island
en.s: The North Cape oil spill took place on Friday, January 19, 1996, when the tank barge North Cape and the tug Scandia grounded on Moonstone Beach in South Kingstown, Rhode Island, after the tug caught fire in its engine room during a winter storm. An estimated 828,000 US gallons (3,130 m3) of home heating oil was spilled.

zh.s: 1996年1月19日星期五，冬季风暴期间，拖船“斯堪迪亚”号机舱起火，随后与油驳船“北角”号一同在罗得岛州南金斯敦的月光石海滩搁浅，造成“北角”号漏油事故。估计有828,000美制加仑（3,130立方米）家用取暖油泄漏。

en.s: 1996 Empress's Cup Final was the 18th final of the Empress's Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on January 19, 1997. Nikko Securities Dream Ladies won the championship.

zh.s: 1997年1月19日，第18届皇后杯决赛在东京国立竞技场举行。日兴证券梦之队夺得冠军。

en.s: The 1997 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the 10th annual Royal Rumble event and took place on January 19, 1997, from the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas. The event was based around the men's Royal Rumble match, a modified 30-man battle royal in which the participants enter at timed intervals instead of all beginning in the ring at the same time and the winner received a WWF Championship match at WrestleMania 13.

zh.s: 1997年1月19日，世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）在美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的阿拉莫穹顶体育馆，举办第十届年度“皇家大战”按次付费赛事。赛事以男子皇家大战为核心，这是30人混战的变体：选手按固定时间间隔依次入场，而非同时开始。胜者可在第13届摔角狂热挑战WWF冠军。

en.s: On January 19, 1999, Pancrase held Breakthrough 1 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.s: 1999年1月19日，Pancrase在日本东京后乐园会馆举办Breakthrough 1综合格斗赛事。

en.s: The 2002 Dallas mayoral special election took place on January 19 and February 16, 2002, to elect the mayor of Dallas, Texas, after Ron Kirk resigned as mayor to run for the United States Senate seat up for election that year. The race was officially nonpartisan. Since no candidate secured a majority in the first round, top-two finishers advanced to a runoff election, which Laura Miller won.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2002年达拉斯市长特别选举首轮
zh.s: 罗恩·柯克辞去达拉斯市长职务，准备竞逐当年改选的联邦参议员席位后，得克萨斯州达拉斯于2002年1月19日和2月16日举行市长特别选举。选举名义上不分党派。由于首轮无人获得过半选票，前两名进入第二轮，最终由劳拉·米勒获胜。
zh.n: 此条记录资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

en.s: Legislative elections were held for the National Assembly of People's Power, Cuba's national legislature, on 19 January 2003. The vote is an endorsement of pre-selected candidates rather than a choice between rivals. Half of the candidates are nominated at public meetings before gaining approval from electoral committees, while the other half are nominated by official mass organisations (such as trade unions, farmers organisations and Students' unions). The government claims that the election represents a show of popular support, but its critics have attributed the result instead to fear or apathy on the part of those who do not support the government.

zh.s: 2003年1月19日，古巴举行全国人民政权代表大会选举。选票是对预先选定候选人的认可，而非在对立候选人之间作选择。一半候选人由公开会议提名，再经选举委员会批准；另一半由官方群众组织提名，例如工会、农民组织及学生会。政府称，结果体现民众支持；批评者则认为，不支持政府者因恐惧或冷漠而参与，才造就这种结果。

en.s: Royal Rumble (2003) was the sixteenth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It took place on January 19, 2003, at the Fleet Center in Boston, Massachusetts, was the first Royal Rumble produced under the WWE name and employed talent from the Raw and SmackDown! brands. As has been customary since 1993, the Royal Rumble match winner received a match at that year's WrestleMania, (in this instance: WrestleMania XIX) for his brand's World title, either the WWE Championship or the World Heavyweight Championship. The main event was the annual 30-man Royal Rumble match, which included wrestlers from both brands.

zh.s: 2003年1月19日，世界摔角娱乐（WWE）在美国马萨诸塞州波士顿的Fleet中心，举办第16届年度“皇家大战”按次付费职业摔角赛。这是首次以WWE名称制作皇家大战，由Raw与SmackDown!两大品牌选手参加。按照1993年以来的惯例，皇家大战胜者可在当年的摔角狂热，此次为第19届，挑战自己品牌的世界冠军，即WWE冠军或世界重量级冠军。压轴赛是年度30人皇家大战，两大品牌均派选手参赛。

en.s: The 2004 Iowa Democratic presidential caucuses were an election held on January 19 as part of the United States presidential primary. They were the first major test of some of the leading contenders for the Democratic Party's nomination as its candidate for the 2004 United States presidential election.

zh.t: 2004年艾奥瓦州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2004年1月19日，艾奥瓦州民主党举行总统党团会议，作为美国总统初选的一部分。这是争取民主党2004年总统候选人提名的数名主要竞争者面临的首次重要考验。

en.t: 2006 Slovak Air Force Antonov An-24 crash
en.s: On 19 January 2006, an Antonov An-24 aircraft operated by the Slovak Air Force crashed in northern Hungary, near the village of Hejce and town of Telkibánya. The airplane was carrying Slovak peacekeepers from Kosovo. Of the 43 people on board, only one survived. The crash remains the deadliest in the area of Hungary and the deadliest in Slovak history.

zh.t: 2006年斯洛伐克空军安-24坠毁事故
zh.s: 2006年1月19日，斯洛伐克空军一架安东诺夫安-24，在匈牙利北部海伊采村及泰尔基巴尼奥镇附近坠毁。飞机载着从科索沃返回的斯洛伐克维和人员，机上43人仅一人生还。这是匈牙利境内及斯洛伐克历史上死亡人数最多的空难。

en.s: On January 19, 2006, NASA’s New Horizons spacecraft launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida, United States, aboard an Atlas V rocket. The mission later made the first close flyby of Pluto and its moons.

zh.s: 2006年1月19日，美国国家航空航天局的“新视野”号探测器搭乘宇宙神V型火箭，从美国佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。该任务后来首次近距离飞掠冥王星及其卫星。

en.s: The prominent Turkish-Armenian journalist Hrant Dink was assassinated in Istanbul on 19 January 2007. Dink was a newspaper editor who had written and spoken about the Armenian genocide and was well known for his efforts for reconciliation between Turks and Armenians and his advocacy of human and minority rights in Turkey. At the time of his death, he was on trial for violating Article 301 of the Turkish Penal Code and "denigrating Turkishness".

zh.s: 2007年1月19日，知名土耳其亚美尼亚裔记者赫兰特·丁克在伊斯坦布尔遇刺。丁克是报纸编辑，曾就亚美尼亚种族灭绝问题撰文和发言，并以推动土耳其人与亚美尼亚人和解、倡导土耳其人权及少数群体权利而闻名。遇害时，他正因涉嫌违反土耳其刑法第301条、“侮辱土耳其性”而受审。

en.s: UFC 80: Rapid Fire was a mixed martial arts (MMA) event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), that took place on January 19, 2008 at the Metro Radio Arena in Newcastle, United Kingdom.

zh.s: 2008年1月19日，终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）在英国纽卡斯尔的Metro Radio竞技场，举办综合格斗赛事“UFC 80：速射”。

en.s: The 2008 Nevada Democratic presidential caucuses took place on January 19, 2008 after having been moved from a later date by the Nevada Democratic Party. The Nevada Democratic Caucus was considered important in determining the eventual party nominee, as many described it as the "Bellwether of the West" seeing as how it is the first Western state to vote in the Democratic Presidential Primary season.

zh.t: 2008年美国民主党内华达州总统候选人党团会议
zh.s: 2008年1月19日，民主党在内华达州举行总统候选人党团会议。该州民主党此前将日期从更晚的时间提前。由于内华达是当年民主党总统初选中首个投票的西部州，许多人称它为“西部风向标”，认为其对最终提名人选具有重要影响。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2008 Nevada Republican presidential caucuses was held on January 19, the same day as the 2008 South Carolina Republican primary, with 31 delegates at stake. Mitt Romney was the winner in Nevada with 51% of the votes, with Ron Paul in second place. Half of Romney's votes came from Mormons, while two-thirds of the independent voters favored Paul.

zh.t: 2008年内华达州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2008年1月19日，内华达州共和党举行总统党团会议，与南卡罗来纳州共和党初选同日进行，共涉及31个代表名额。米特·罗姆尼获得51%的选票获胜，罗恩·保罗排名第二。罗姆尼所得选票有一半来自摩门教徒，而三分之二的独立选民支持保罗。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2008 South Carolina Republican presidential primary was held on January 19, with 24 delegates at stake. The Republican National Committee took half of South Carolina's 47 delegates away from them because the state committee moved its Republican primary before February 5. It was held on the same day as the Nevada Republican caucuses, 2008.

zh.t: 2008年南卡罗来纳州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年1月19日，南卡罗来纳州共和党举行总统初选，共涉及24个代表名额。由于该州共和党委员会将初选日期提前至2月5日之前，共和党全国委员会削减了该州原有47个代表名额中的一半。初选与内华达州共和党党团会议同日举行。

en.s: An election for the Tobago House of Assembly (THA) was held on January 19, 2009. The PNM won 8 seats and obtained 51.48% of the votes while the TOP won 4 seats and 48.32% of the votes.

zh.s: 2009年1月19日，多巴哥举行议会选举。人民民族运动获得51.48%的选票，赢得8席；多巴哥人民组织获得48.32%的选票，赢得4席。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Massachusetts, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate special election in Massachusetts was a special election held on January 19, 2010, in order to fill the Massachusetts Class I United States Senate seat for the remainder of the term ending January 3, 2013. It was won by Republican candidate Scott Brown. The vacancy that prompted the special election was created by the death of Democratic Senator Ted Kennedy on August 25, 2009. (Kennedy served as Senator since 1962, having been elected in a special election in 1962 to fill the vacancy created when his brother John F. Kennedy was elected President of the United States in 1960.)

zh.t: 2010年美国马萨诸塞州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 2010年1月19日，马萨诸塞州举行联邦参议员特别选举，填补该州第一组席位至2013年1月3日届满的剩余任期，共和党候选人斯科特·布朗获胜。空缺源于民主党参议员泰德·肯尼迪于2009年8月25日去世。肯尼迪自1962年起担任参议员，当年他也通过特别选举进入参议院，填补其兄约翰·F.肯尼迪于1960年当选美国总统后留下的席位。

en.s: The 2009–10 Birmingham, Alabama mayoral special election was held on January 19, 2010, following a special primary election on December 8, 2009, to elect the mayor of Birmingham, Alabama. Former Mayor Larry Langford was convicted on sixty counts of bribery-related charges on October 28, 2009, and he was automatically removed from office, elevating City Council President Carole Smitherman to the role.

zh.t: 2009—2010年美国阿拉巴马州伯明翰市长特别选举
zh.s: 2009年12月8日举行特别初选后，美国阿拉巴马州伯明翰于2010年1月19日举行市长特别选举。前市长拉里·兰福德于2009年10月28日被判六十项贿赂相关罪名成立，自动失去职务，市议会议长卡萝尔·史密瑟曼随后接任。

en.t: UFC on FX: Belfort vs. Bisping
en.s: On January 19, 2013, UFC held UFC on FX: Belfort vs. Bisping, also known as UFC on FX 7, at Ginásio do Ibirapuera in São Paulo, Brazil.

zh.t: UFC on FX 7综合格斗赛事
zh.s: 2013年1月19日，UFC在巴西圣保罗的伊比拉普埃拉体育馆举办UFC on FX：Belfort vs. Bisping赛事，也称UFC on FX 7。

en.s: On 19 January 2014, a Taliban bombing targeted Pakistani soldiers in Bannu, Pakistan, killing and injuring members of the security forces.

zh.s: 2014年1月19日，塔利班在巴基斯坦巴努对巴基斯坦军人发动爆炸袭击，造成安全部队人员伤亡。

en.s: La Copa Junior (2016) (Spanish for "The Junior Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament ran from January 5, 2016 to January 19, 2016 in Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. CMLL's recurring La Copa Junior tournament featured second, third or fourth generation wrestlers completing against each other.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2016年1月5日至19日，墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场策划并举办“二代杯”（La Copa Junior）职业摔角锦标赛。西班牙语名称意为“后辈杯”。这是CMLL定期举办的赛事，参赛者均为摔角世家的第二、第三或第四代选手。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的赛事日期。

en.s: On 19 January 2017, Ronna McDaniel was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in the United States, succeeding Reince Priebus.

zh.t: 罗娜·麦克丹尼尔当选共和党全国委员会主席
zh.s: 2017年1月19日，罗娜·麦克丹尼尔接替赖因斯·普里巴斯，当选美国共和党全国委员会主席。

en.s: On 19 January 2017, forces from member states of the Economic Community of West African States entered The Gambia after Yahya Jammeh refused to step down following his defeat by Adama Barrow in the 2016 presidential election.

zh.t: 西共体军队进入冈比亚
zh.s: 2017年1月19日，西非国家经济共同体成员国的军队进入冈比亚。此前，叶海亚·贾梅在2016年总统选举中败给阿达马·巴罗，却拒绝卸任。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Trinidad and Tobago on 19 January 2018. On 5 January 2018, the name of Paula-Mae Weekes, a judge of the Turks and Caicos Islands Court of Appeal, was put forward by the PNM government of Prime Minister Keith Rowley in hopes of reaching a consensus with the UNC-led parliamentary opposition of Kamla Persad-Bissessar, which later indeed endorsed her nomination as well.

zh.t: 2018年特立尼达和多巴哥总统选举
zh.s: 2018年1月19日，特立尼达和多巴哥举行间接总统选举。1月5日，基思·罗利总理领导的人民民族运动政府，提名特克斯和凯科斯群岛上诉法院法官保拉-梅·威克斯，希望与卡姆拉·佩尔萨德-比塞萨尔领导、以联合民族大会为主的议会反对派达成共识。反对派后来确实支持了她的提名。

en.s: On 19 January 2018, Chiangrai United won the Thailand Champions Cup at Supachalasai Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand. After a 2–2 draw with Buriram United, Chiangrai won the penalty shoot-out 6–5.

zh.s: 2018年1月19日，清莱联在泰国曼谷素帕猜拉赛体育场夺得泰国冠军杯。清莱联与武里南联以2比2战平，随后通过点球大战以6比5获胜。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Cejudo vs. Dillashaw
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Cejudo vs. Dillashaw (also known as UFC Fight Night 143 or UFC on ESPN+ 1) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on January 19, 2019, at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：塞胡多对阵迪拉肖
zh.s: 2019年1月19日，终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）在美国纽约布鲁克林的巴克莱中心，举办综合格斗赛事“塞胡多对阵迪拉肖”，又称UFC格斗之夜143或UFC on ESPN+ 1。

en.s: On January 19, 2019, ONE Championship held ONE: Eternal Glory at Istora Senayan in Jakarta, Indonesia.

zh.s: 2019年1月19日，ONE Championship在印度尼西亚雅加达的史纳延体育馆举办ONE：Eternal Glory格斗赛事。

en.t: 2020 Tobago Council of the People's National Movement leadership election
en.s: The 2020 Tobago Council of the People's National Movement election were held on January 19, 2020. For the first time, a one member, one vote voting system was adopted for all 17 positions contested. The winner, Tracy Davidson-Celestine, the first female political leader for the party, will go on to contest the Chief Secretary position of the Tobago House of Assembly in the 2021 Tobago House of Assembly election.

zh.t: 2020年人民民族运动多巴哥理事会领导层选举
zh.s: 2020年1月19日，人民民族运动多巴哥理事会举行选举，首次对全部17个竞选职位采用一人一票制。获胜的特雷西·戴维森-塞莱斯廷成为该党首位女性政治领袖，并准备在2021年多巴哥议会选举中争取首席秘书职位。

en.t: 2020 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final
en.s: The 2020 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final was a hurling match which was played at Croke Park on 19 January 2020 to determine the winners of the 2019-20 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, the 50th season of the All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion clubs of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 2020年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2020年1月19日，全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛决赛在克罗克公园举行，决出2019至2020赛季的冠军。这是该锦标赛的第50个赛季，由盖尔运动协会组织，参赛队伍为爱尔兰四省的冠军俱乐部。

en.s: On January 19, 2020, Brave Combat Federation and World Freefight Challenge held BRAVE CF 34 at Hala Tivoli in Ljubljana, Slovenia.

zh.s: 2020年1月19日，Brave Combat Federation与World Freefight Challenge在斯洛文尼亚卢布尔雅那的蒂沃利体育馆举办BRAVE CF 34综合格斗赛事。

en.s: General elections were held in Barbados on 19 January 2022 to elect the 30 members of the House of Assembly. The ruling Barbados Labour Party won all 30 seats for the second consecutive election. This was the 12th national election held since independence from the United Kingdom in 1966, the 16th since the institution of universal suffrage in 1951, and the first since Barbados became a republic in 2021.

zh.s: 2022年1月19日，巴巴多斯举行大选，选出众议院30名议员。执政的巴巴多斯工党连续第二次赢得全部30席。这是该国1966年脱离英国独立后的第12次全国选举、1951年实行普选后的第16次，也是2021年改为共和国后的首次。

en.t: Japan’s SLIM probe lands on the Moon
en.s: On 19 January 2024 at 15:20 UTC, Japan’s SLIM spacecraft achieved a soft landing on the Moon. Japan became the fifth country to achieve a lunar soft landing. In Japan, it was already 20 January.
en.n: The date is UTC; the landing occurred on January 20 in Japan.

zh.s: 2024年1月19日15时20分（协调世界时），日本SLIM探测器实现月球软着陆，日本由此成为第五个实现月球软着陆的国家。日本当地此时已是1月20日。
zh.n: 日期采用协调世界时；日本当地为1月20日。

en.s: The 2025 Burgenland state election took place on 19 January 2025. The governing Social Democrats (SPÖ) lost their absolute majority and needed a coalition partner to govern. The People's Party (ÖVP) lost significantly and received its worst result ever in the state. Conversely, the Freedom Party (FPÖ) more than doubled its share and received its best result ever.

zh.s: 2025年1月19日，奥地利布尔根兰州举行选举。执政的社会民主党失去绝对多数，必须寻找联合执政伙伴。人民党明显失利，取得该党在本州史上最差成绩。相反，自由党的得票率翻了一倍多，创下该党在本州的最佳纪录。

en.s: The 2025 edition of Genesis was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It took place on January 19, 2025, at the Curtis Culwell Center in Garland, Texas. It was the thirteenth event under the Genesis chronology, and the first to be held since the 2021 event. The event also featured wrestlers from WWE's NXT brand.

zh.s: 2025年1月19日，TNA职业摔角联盟在美国得克萨斯州加兰的柯蒂斯·卡尔韦尔中心，举办第13届“创世纪”按次付费赛事。这是2021年以来该系列首次再办，也有WWE旗下NXT品牌选手参加。
